idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.14.2

  • Build fix: stopButton declaration referenced iconInsets before it was initialized. Kotlin initializes properties in source order, so iconInsets had to move above the buttons that use it.

0.14.1

  • Toggle buttons (Current file / Selection / Plan) get an explicit empty border so the L&F's default ButtonBorder no longer reserves padding even when isBorderPainted is false. Plan in particular is noticeably tighter now.

0.14.0

  • Text input now spans the full panel width. Send + Stop moved to the action row's far right.
  • Action row consolidated: + and attach toggles on the left; Plan, hamburger, Stop (icon, visible only while busy), and Send on the right.
  • Buttons tightened: + and hamburger and Stop are zero-padding 20x20 icons; toggle buttons (Current file / Selection / Plan) lose vertical padding and use 6px horizontal padding.
  • Stop is now an icon (AllIcons.Actions.Suspend) instead of a text button.

0.13.0

  • Streaming responses no longer choke the EDT. Deltas accumulate into a buffer that's flushed to the JTextPane via a 50ms Timer, instead of re-rendering the entire HTML transcript on every chunk. Long replies appear smoothly now and the Send button no longer gets stuck on "Sending..." behind a backlog of paint events.
  • New Stop button appears to the left of Send while a request is in flight. Click it to cancel - the in-flight pooled task is interrupted, late callbacks are dropped via a generation counter, and the user turn is rolled back so you can edit and retry.

0.12.0

  • "+" menu Browse files... now opens IntelliJ's file chooser and accepts any file type (the previous Swing JFileChooser was sometimes filtering to images on some platforms). Text files are attached as-is; binary non-image files are rejected with a chat warning.
  • New "+" menu entry: "Image from clipboard" - appears when an image is on the system clipboard, so you can paste a screenshot without focusing the input.
  • Remove (X) buttons on pending attachments are now icon-only, borderless, 16x16 - much less visual weight.
  • Action-row buttons (attach toggles, Plan, +, hamburger) use a flat / borderless style, matching JetBrains AI Assistant's inline controls. Toggles still fill blue when armed.

0.11.0

  • Bottom controls consolidated into a single tight row: + dropdown, Current file toggle, Selection toggle on the left; Plan toggle + hamburger on the right. Smaller font and tighter
